products.name: Air Jordan 1 Retro Low OG "Howard"
products.description:
Jordan Brand and Howard University team up again. This AJ1 Low brings inspiration from MJ's original 1985 game shoe. The College Navy and University Red color scheme brings the esteemed HBCU's colors to the forefront, and the Howard Bison are honored on the heel. Smooth satin wraps the upper, while luxe suede accents soften the finish.

SKU: IX8478-410

products.name: Caitlin 1 "Caitlin Blue"
products.description:
The wait is nearly over. Change the game in the Caitlin 1. Her step-back creates space on demand. Her first step sets the pace. A responsive Air Zoom Turbo unit paired with Cushlon foam helps you stay smooth and controlled through every move. The innovative Nike Opticast upper delivers lightweight, locked-in support, so you can push tempo without feeling weighed down. Finished with signature details special to Caitlin, this shoe is made for hoopers who shoot without hesitation and make logo splashes the new normal.

Caitlin was hands-on with our designers, obsessing to get every detail right. See it in the double Swoosh logo that nods to her initials and the three-point arc. Look closely for the 22’s and CC’s molded into the upper. Her signature pops on the heel and her logo on the midfoot reflects her range from anywhere.

Caitlin’s game goes wherever you step. Both shoes read “It was never a long shot,” with “Shoot more threes” on the left and “From anywhere” on the right.

SKU: IH7423-400

products.name: Air Jordan 1 High OG "Royal"
products.description:
First released in 1985, the AJ1 set the tone for years of innovation through the Air Jordan signature line. More than four decades since the design forever changed the future of footwear, the debut AJ1 "Royal" returns true to form.

SKU: IQ5495-005

products.name: Nike General Purpose
products.description:
Demerits are points against a student's record for breaking the rules.

"I was almost expelled from high school for wearing my soccer shoes to class instead of the all-black dress shoes that were required by school policy", Tom Sachs remembers. That’s when I figured out I could just color in the white swoosh with a marker to avoid demerits."

Test limits by breaking the rules. Accept the penalties but never forget them. Artists are champions who push up to the edge of what can be achieved through work. Wear your demerits with pride so you can live without regret.

SKU: FZ1363-002

products.name: Nike Air Bakin High SP
products.description:
Go big or go home. The Air Bakin reemerges from the vault for just the second time, stomping back onto the court in its original heat-worthy colorway. The chunky silhouette features a ribbed upper in Varsity Red and black, with plenty of padding and a generous high cut around the ankle. Max Air in the heel and additional Air in the forefoot adds a bit of bounce to lighten your step.

SKU: IQ5365-600

products.name: Kobe 10 Protro "Blue Lagoon"
products.description:
First released in 2015, the Kobe 10 gets remastered with a Protro performance overhaul. Marking the return of the silhouette's original launch colorway, the Blue Lagoon palette honors the drive and determination that fueled a legendary recovery.

The Protro model comes fully equipped with a full-length Air Zoom strobel underfoot and advanced Cushlon 3.0 foam to bring energy return and elite comfort to the modern hooper. A streamlined mesh upper creates a more flexible and breathable forefoot fit, while a midsole carbon wing helps enhance lateral containment and support. Maintaining the iconic Kobe X design, the outsole grip pattern has been computationally enhanced to showcase impeccable footwork like never before.

SKU: IQ5339-400

products.name: Nike Air Max Goadome Low
products.description:
The Air Max Goadome Low takes the rugged aspects of the outdoor classic and redesigns the upper for a sleeker, more streamlined boot. And they're done up in all black for you to dress up or kick it casual.

SKU: IV4517-001

products.description: Color: Pearl Blue / Asphalt / Black Color: Black / Black / Black Color: Coyote Brown / Willow / Dragon Fire Color: Paloma / Cloudburst / Ftw Silver The XT-4 OG GTX trail running shoe has been revived from the archives to take on urban outings. Overflowing with archive style and Salomon details, this sneaker celebrates Salomon's greatest past innovations. Added GORE-TEX protection brings versatility in any weather so you can celebrate the history of a true trail legend in style. This shoe stays true to its original design and has been authentically replicated for maximum archive style. GORE-TEX waterproof protection brings versatility in any weather.  The full-length Agile Chassis™ Skeleton that once provided trail runners with exceptional stability over any distance feels ultimately secure and stable in urban environments.  Originally made for running long-distances, the dual-density EVA cushioning in the midsole protects and cushions your feet for all-day comfort on city streets.  *   **quickLACE™:**Minimalistic and strong lace for one-pull tightening.
